name: hazy-readme-cards
description: A high-performance, theme-aware terminal UI dashboard and custom pixel art setup for GitHub READMEs.

paragraphs: Dynamic, terminal-inspired SVG cards engineered to build a striking, cohesive GitHub Profile README.

Hazy Readme Cards turns your GitHub profile into a live, interactive hacker terminal. Instead of embedding static images that get outdated, this project provides a set of serverless API endpoints that generate dynamic, crisp SVG cards in real-time.

Is your token safe? Yes. Your token is stored encrypted in Vercel's private environment variables. It runs purely on the server/edge backend and is never exposed to the browser, public web, or generated SVG output.
features: Bypass GitHub Rate Limits: Without a token, GitHub strictly limits unauthenticated API requests to 60 requests per hour per IP address. Because Vercel functions share server IP pools, your cards will quickly hit rate…
Access Real-Time Contributions & GraphQL: GitHub requires an authenticated token to query the GraphQL API for accurate annual commits, PRs, and language breakdown statistics.
